I've subscribed to the PR and will chime in as it progresses. yeah, that will come much later I'll ping you when we start implementing this <@861612909854588938> It would be great if the Flashbots builder could build on the parent when the block is later than 4s 🙏 I've been trying to get some re-orgs on Goerli but so far the only builder giving me re-org blocks is BloxRoute: <https://gist.github.com/michaelsproul/720459c93f20ee61911ab1732337f7ca> There have been several cases where Lighthouse has pulled off a re-org on a block that was 4-6s late, using a local execution payload, e.g. <https://goerli.beaconcha.in/slot/4529267>

excerpts.content:
<@861612909854588938> It would be great if the Flashbots builder could build on the parent when the block is later than 4s 🙏 I've been trying to get some re-orgs on Goerli but so far the only builder giving me re-org blocks is BloxRoute: <https://gist.github.com/michaelsproul/720459c93f20ee61911ab1732337f7ca>

There have been several cases where Lighthouse has pulled off a re-org on a block that was 4-6s late, using a local execution payload, e.g. <https://goerli.beaconcha.in/slot/4529267>
